# telemetry-varint-stream

Behavior contract:
decodeVarints(chunks) consumes a finite iterable of Uint8Array chunks and returns unsigned 64-bit values as BigInts. Each value uses minimal base-128 little-endian varint encoding: low 7 bits are payload, high bit is continuation. Values may cross chunk boundaries; empty chunks are ignored. Reject unfinished values, encodings longer than 10 bytes, values above 2^64-1, and nonminimal encodings (a multi-byte encoding whose final payload is zero), using RangeError. Do not mutate chunks.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`.
Use only the runtime standard library. Preserve public interfaces and existing assertions; do not install dependencies or access the network.
